subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers require a redacted live Socket Mode envelope before approving a code fix for this reaction-specific report?
rationale: Current source proves the handlers and filters exist, but it does not identify where the reported live event first disappears.

options.title: Wait for live envelope proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and require current-main or newest-release envelope fields plus nearby Gateway logs before authorizing a fix.

options.title: Authorize exploratory source fix
options.body: Allow a fix PR based on suspected filter or authorization behavior, accepting a higher chance of patching the wrong boundary.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode tracking
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery cluster, risking loss of the reaction-specific reproduction detail.

recommendation.title: Wait for live envelope proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require current-main or newest-release envelope fields plus nearby Gateway logs before authorizing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the issue and already stated the proof needed to separate Slack/Bolt delivery from OpenClaw filtering.
